criteria.reason: src/recipe/block.json has apiVersion 3, "render": "file:./render.php", "viewScriptModule": "file:./view.js" and supports.interactivity: true.
recipe-scaler.php calls register_block_type( __DIR__ . '/build/recipe' ) inside recipe_scaler_register_block, which is hooked to 'init'.
block.json defines title (string, ''), servings (number, 4) and ingredients (array of objects with quantity/unit/name, default []).

edit.js uses RichText for the title and __experimentalNumberControl inside InspectorControls > PanelBody for servings; ingredients can be edited in the canvas with NumberControl/TextControl, and add/remove Buttons are included.
view.js imports { store, getContext } from '@wordpress/interactivity' and defines store('recipe-scaler') with getters state.isMinimum and state.scaledQuantity and actions increase/decrease.
render.php puts data-wp-interactive="recipe-scaler" on the wrapper div.
render.php calls wp_interactivity_data_wp_context( $recipe_scaler_context ) on the wrapper and gives each li its own index context the same way.
The buttons have data-wp-on--click="actions.decrease" and data-wp-on--click="actions.increase".
data-wp-text="context.servings" is on the output element and data-wp-text="state.scaledQuantity" on each quantity span.
The − button has data-wp-bind--disabled="state.isMinimum" (servings <= 1), and disabled() renders the attribute on the server.
render.php calls wp_interactivity_state('recipe-scaler', ...) with closures that use wp_interactivity_get_context(), and prints the initial servings and formatted quantities on the server.
view.js formatQuantity uses Math.round((q+EPSILON)*100)/100, and PHP recipe_scaler_format_quantity uses round($q, 2).
render.php escapes with esc_html, esc_attr_e, esc_html_e, wp_kses_post for the title and get_block_wrapper_attributes for the wrapper, and sanitizes ingredients first.

Every API used exists in WordPress/Gutenberg, including wp_interactivity_state, wp_interactivity_get_context, wp_interactivity_data_wp_context, disabled(), __experimentalNumberControl, store and getContext.
package.json lists @wordpress/scripts in devDependencies, and its build/start scripts pass --experimental-modules.
